about_the_game:
That dastardly cat Mr. Skritch has trapped your birdie friends inside magical gems - and now he's cackling with glee! In this demo you'll Join Sandy on the opening chapters of her delightful treasure hunt across the enchanting Komio Island to rescue your first Bird-Buddies before Skritch's mischievous minions cause even more trouble.

Explore the first 2 hand-crafted worlds where curiosity is rewarded and every corner hides a surprise. From hidden passages to secret powerups, this cozy adventure celebrates the joy of discovery rather than punishing precision.

Get a taste of Sandy's wonderfully weird abilities - bounce with Bubble-Seeds, stomp with Bomb-Boots, electrify with Mag-Zaps or gallop on Dashing Ponies. The ultra-rare ScootyCopter awaits the most dedicated explorers!

Face off against an army of adorable troublemakers in this preview of the complete Super Komio Island experience.

This demo showcases a bright, wholesome love letter to classic platformers lovingly crafted by a solo developer with a passion for colourful worlds full of surprises.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 3.0 compatible GPU
